biography.value:
Description

Kefka led a larger Imperial force to Narshe to lay siege the city and take the frozen esper.

Defense

AC 13, touch 13, flat-footed 10 (+3 Dex)

hp 65 [90] (5d6+15)

mp 17

Fort +7; Ref +7; Will +6

Immune Banish, Berserk, Blind, Confuse, Daze, Death, Disable, Doom, Gravity, Frog, Mini, Paralyzed, Petrification/Statue, Sap, Silence, Sleep, Stop, Stun, Zombie;

Offense

Speed 30 ft.

Melee Dagger +1 (1d4-1/x2)

Ranged Power Staff: Lightning +5 (1d6+5)

Special Abilities Elemental Shield 4 (9/day), Elemental Seal (1/day), Metamagic Enhancement (3/day)

Limit Breaks Mana Wall, Spell Fury

Spells Known (Black Mage CL 5th, concentration +11)

0th (DC 16) - Alter Food, Alter Object, Elemental Orb, Ignite, Message

1st (DC 17) - Blizzard, Dark, Icicle Dagger, Enduring Elements, Enfeeblement, Mage Armor, Ruin, Shield, Shocking Grasp, Slick, Spark, Thunder, Water

2nd (DC 18) - Blizzard II, Icy Breath, Poison, Thunder II

3rd (DC 19) - Blizzara, Thundara

Statistics

Str 8, Dex 16, Con 16, Int 22, Wis 14, Cha 10

Base Atk +5; CMB +4; CMD 17

Feats Extra MP, Improved Initiative, Intensified Spell, Point-Blank Shot

Skills Appraise +10, Knowledge (Arcana) +10, Knowledge (Dungeoneering) +10, Knowledge (Geography) +10, Knowledge (History) +10, Knowledge (Local) +10, Knowledge (Planes) +10, Knowledge (Technology) +10, Perception +3, Spellcraft +10

Languages Crazy, Common

SQ Black Magery (Increased Damage +2), Mage Talent (Creative Destruction, Empowered Magic), Clear Mind, Dark Affliction, Focused Caster, Spell Proficiency

Gear Dagger, Power Staff: Lightning, Cure Potion x2, Ether x1

GM note: Five additional languages are unspecified. Enduring Elements uses the Endure Elements spell document. Retain printed BAB +5, weapon attacks +1/+5, and the 17 MP class pool including Extra MP.

description.value: Elemental Shield

effect: Immediate: self and allies within 30 ft gain resistance 4 to the six primary elements for one round.

description.value: Elemental Seal

effect: Next elemental spell of standard casting time or faster: x1.5 damage and halve the target's resistance. Cannot combine with metamagic.

description.value: Metamagic Enhancement

effect: Reduce one metamagic MP surcharge by 1, never below the base cost. Excludes Heighten Spell.

description.value: After dealing elemental spell damage, gain temporary HP equal to its number of damage dice for one hour. Temporary HP do not stack.

effect: After dealing elemental spell damage, gain temporary HP equal to its number of damage dice for one hour. Temporary HP do not stack.

description.value: Empowered Magic

effect: Apply Empower Spell to one spell without increasing its MP cost.

description.value: Resistance 4 to fire, ice, lightning, water, earth and wind. Apply to affected allies as well.
Limit Breaks

effect: Automatically absorb 5 damage per MP for two rounds; ends immediately when out of MP. Combat only, after enemy damage at or below half HP (ignore temporary HP); self-inflicted crossing of the threshold prevents activation for one round.

Two rounds: declare both standard-or-faster black magic spells before resolving either; cast simultaneously as one standard action, paying for both.
